$comment: Canonical column definitions for the five SharePoint lists used by the template regeneration solution. See docs/Template-Regeneration-Solution-Design.md section 4. Applied via provisioning/pnp-provisioning-template.xml.

lists.name: DocumentIndex
lists.description: One row per file in scope. Maintained by Flow E (backfill) and Flow F (delta). Read by Flow A to resolve affected documents without walking the tree.
lists.keyRationale: SharePoint file GUID, not path. Paths change on folder rename; a path key silently produces duplicate rows, which means duplicate agent calls and duplicate cost.

columns.name: UniqueId
columns.description: SharePoint file GUID. Primary key.

columns.name: ListItemId
columns.description: Stable library item ID used by the created/modified trigger, including rename events.

columns.name: FileName
columns.description: Leaf file name including extension.

columns.name: ServerRelativeUrl
columns.description: Full server-relative path of the file.

columns.name: ParentFolderUrl
columns.description: Server-relative path of the containing folder. The index itself is scoped to the configured root, so planning does not filter on this non-indexable long path.

columns.name: ParentFolderUniqueId
columns.description: SharePoint folder GUID. Used with DocumentStem to find PDF/DOCX members of one document group without filtering on long paths.

columns.name: DocumentStem
columns.description: Lower-case file name without extension. Paired with ParentFolderUniqueId for source preference.

columns.name: DocumentKey
columns.description: Stable logical document key: parent folder GUID plus lower-case stem. Survives PDF/DOCX replacement and drives idempotency.

columns.name: Extension
columns.description: Lower-case extension including the dot, e.g. .docx

columns.name: SizeBytes
columns.description: File size. Used by output validation size bounds.

columns.name: TimeLastModified
columns.description: SharePoint last modified timestamp.

columns.name: Depth
columns.description: Folder depth below the root folder. Diagnostics and walk sizing.

columns.name: DocumentRole
columns.description: Source documents are regenerated. Outputs are written to. Templates trigger runs. Archived rows are previous output versions.

columns.name: LastSeenRunId
columns.description: Stamped by every backfill. Rows not seen by a completed backfill are stale, i.e. the file was probably deleted.

columns.name: IsExcluded
columns.description: Row retained for audit but never selected as a regeneration source.

columns.name: IndexedAt
columns.description: When this row was last written by Flow E or F.

lists.name: RegenerationRun
lists.description: One row per regeneration job. Created by Flow A, advanced by Flow B, closed by Flow C.

columns.name: RunId
columns.description: GUID generated by Flow A.

columns.name: RunKey
columns.description: Template publication identity plus dry/live mode. Used to suppress duplicate active runs; completed error runs may be retried.

columns.name: TemplateName
columns.description: Template whose publication triggered this run.

columns.name: TemplateFingerprint
columns.description: Stable identity of the explicitly published template version. Used for trigger idempotency and prior-success filtering.

columns.name: TemplateUrl
columns.description: Exact server-relative path of the published template passed to every work item.

columns.name: TemplateVersion
columns.description: SharePoint version label of the template file.

columns.name: Status
columns.description: Run lifecycle. Flow B resumes Running before promoting Approved; C aggregates counts in Finalizing; rollback first locks a terminal run as RollbackInProgress.

columns.name: ApprovalDecision
columns.description: First human decision entered on the SharePoint run item and applied by A3.

columns.name: SecondConfirmation
columns.description: Required as Confirmed when PlannedCount exceeds MaxDocumentsPerRun.

columns.name: PlannedCount
columns.description: Work items created by Flow A after cost filters.

columns.name: AgentCallCount
columns.description: HEADLINE COST METRIC. Reported by Flow C. If this approaches PlannedCount on every run, the cost filters are not working.

columns.name: IsDryRun
columns.description: Plan-only run. Work items are created for inspection and never executed.

columns.name: RequiresSecondConfirmation
columns.description: Set when PlannedCount exceeds MaxDocumentsPerRun. Circuit breaker.

columns.name: PlanningCursorId
columns.description: Highest DocumentIndex item ID consumed by the paged planner.

columns.name: IndexSnapshotRunId
columns.description: WalkRunId of the completed snapshot that authorized planning.

columns.name: IndexSnapshotItemId
columns.description: IndexWalkRun list item ID. Any newer walk invalidates this plan before approval.

columns.name: FinalizationCursorId
columns.description: Highest work-item ID counted by paged finalization.

columns.name: RollbackCursorId
columns.description: Highest side-effect manifest processed by paged rollback.

columns.name: SummaryMessage
columns.description: Written by Flow C.

lists.name: RegenerationWorkItem
lists.description: The work queue. One row per document per run. Written by Flow A, claimed and updated by Flow B. Persisting this state is what makes the job resumable, bounded in run duration, and immune to the 16 MB action output cap.

columns.name: RunId
columns.description: Groups items into a run. Queried by Flow B every cycle, so it must be indexed.

columns.name: SourceUniqueId
columns.description: SharePoint GUID of the source document. Idempotency key.

columns.name: SourceDocumentKey
columns.description: Stable logical document key copied from DocumentIndex. Primary idempotency key across source replacement.

columns.name: SourceUrl
columns.description: Server-relative path of the source document.

columns.name: SourceSizeBytes
columns.description: Size of the source document, copied from the index for planning and diagnostics.

columns.name: TemplateFingerprint
columns.description: Recorded so cost filter F3 can skip already-current outputs on a re-run.

columns.name: TemplateUrl
columns.description: Exact template file path supplied to the agent for this source document.

columns.name: Status
columns.description: Queried by Flow B every cycle, so it must be indexed.

columns.name: AttemptCount
columns.description: Bounded by MaxAttempts, then parked as Failed. Unbounded retry on a deterministic failure exhausts quota.

columns.name: ValidationResult
columns.description: Why an agent report was rejected or classified as failed.

columns.name: AgentResultJson
columns.description: Verbatim parsed agent report, including every output, byte-verification verdict and archived filename. Source of truth for rollback.

columns.name: HasAgentManifest
columns.description: True when AgentResultJson contains a parsed report or raw response requiring rollback review. Used instead of filtering the non-filterable Note payload.

columns.name: RollbackResultJson
columns.description: Machine-readable record of restored files and rollback failures.

columns.name: ClaimedAt
columns.description: Used with StaleClaimMinutes to reap items stranded by a crashed batch.

columns.name: ClaimedBy
columns.description: Flow run identifier that claimed this item. Prevents double processing.

lists.name: WalkFrontier
lists.description: The folder walk frontier for Flow E. Persisted rather than held in an array variable so the walk is resumable after a failed run, observable while running, and immune to the 16 MB action output cap.

columns.name: WalkRunId
columns.description: Groups frontier rows into one backfill pass.

columns.name: FolderUrl
columns.description: Server-relative path of a folder awaiting enumeration.

columns.name: FolderUniqueId
columns.description: SharePoint folder GUID copied to child index rows as ParentFolderUniqueId.

columns.name: Depth
columns.description: Depth below the root folder. Supports breadth-first ordering.

columns.name: Status
columns.description: Queried every chunk, so it must be indexed.

columns.name: ErrorMessage
columns.description: Recorded when a folder cannot be enumerated, e.g. a single folder with more than 5,000 direct children throttling its own call.

lists.name: IndexWalkRun
lists.description: Header and reconciliation cursor for one complete index backfill. A walk is not complete until its frontier is drained and stale rows from the prior snapshot are excluded.

columns.name: WalkRunId
columns.description: Groups one complete traversal and reconciliation pass.

columns.name: Status
columns.description: E2 ignores Seeding until the root frontier exists. Planning relies only on Completed snapshots. Folder deletion can queue one follow-up walk.

columns.name: ReconciliationCursorId
columns.description: Highest DocumentIndex item ID reconciled against this walk.
